steps.text: Slice, pierce, cleave, sweep, the blades flutter in lockstep with the enemy.
Wail, rage, curse, howl, and then all tends towards the serene.
Rosmontis's expression holds not the slightest change.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Dealt with.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There's no front or ambush positions left. We can continue forward.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You do a pretty job, Feline. Settled it without any of us even taking a scratch.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And you skewer their heads real fast, real precise, no hesitation. That's good form.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If only we didn't know you killed the Captain, I'd probably ask you to join us.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You're a natural-born warrior. Shame you're with that Cautus, damn shame.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You can't say bad things about Amiya.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No, I'm not criticizing her now.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I'd been wanting to hear the things she said long, long ago, things I'd heard before.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: She's great, Feline. A true great one.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But this won't get you anywhere, Feline, it won't get you anywhere.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't believe you. Amiya will be able to do it.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Maybe. But you, with her, it's no good for either of you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You're two kinds of people.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What two kinds of people? Me and Amiya get along really well. She's taught me a lot of things.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Heh, you'll figure in time.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're doing this on purpose... I don't want to know.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What you just said. I could join you?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You can.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We welcome anyone.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: As long as you feel the Infected's fate is unfair, as long as Ursus gets you burning mad, as long as you want to fight.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You can join us, then.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You thought our team only had Ursus in it? Thought it only kept this country's people? Think again, Feline.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...You're a Feline too.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Born in Rim Billiton, went with my parents to Ursus, and settled down afterwards in this frigid place.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I liked picking fights ever since I was young. Decided to join the army later because of it.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Ursus's assessments for joining the army are pretty harsh on Felines, but I still passed.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And after, I joined the Captain's unit, and went with him, fighting campaigns far and wide. That was ten years.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Wars, following wars, and always a war after that. That's Ursus.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I used to feel proud of this country, kid.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Countless among us used to feel proud of this country.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: So, why...?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Because my parents got Oripathy, got kicked out of the city, and died in the wilderness.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And I only learned about it half a year after they'd kicked the bucket.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Countless among us have gone through something similar.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I heard you went through something similar too, kid.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But it's not just that.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If it was just that, just the one misfortune I ever happened across, I might even be able to understand it.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But. That's not how it is.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: War used to be the only thing that existed inside my head, and the only thing I ever reckoned to accomplish.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I started reflecting, thinking some things over, and only then did I start figuring something out about this country, trying to understand this country I used to struggle for.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If the Captain weren't there, I'd have probably long been court-martialed for making disrespectful remarks at HQ.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: After that, I went to the Northern Plains with the Captain.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And the rest is history.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: In all of this, I've learned endurance, learned rage, learned hatred.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Amiya told me not to learn these.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You'll learn them one way or the other, kid.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you can't use them, chances are they'll swallow you up.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: So, was Patriot your family, then?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We fought together for twenty years. He was my best brother, my closest brother-in-arms, and the one I most respected.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: He was, kid.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But I've still gotta say, you're all the more suited to join us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then would Amiya be able to join you?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That Cautus? Nope, she wouldn't work.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: She can't join us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then I won't join you.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hah. I told you. You killed the Captain. There's no way you'd be able to join.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But personally speaking, you need to pay a bit more attention to her. She wants to protect you, but she'll probably die faster than you will.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why are you that sure?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Because we've met someone like her before.
The Shieldguard looks like he's thinking back to something. He pays no more attention to Rosmontis, puts on his helmet once again, and walks off to his comrades-in-arms.
